The most criticism lands on AF for video: 26% positive, 32% neutral, 42% negative across 19 claims. Opinion is split on bokeh (10 positive, 10 neutral, 6 negative claims). AF performance splits by use case: stills sentiment runs net positive (10/3/5 across 18), while video sentiment runs net negative (5/6/8 across 19).
